Monday, 21 December, 2009/30 Agrahayana, 1931 (Saka) 
The House met at eleven of the clock, 
MR. CHAIRMAN in the Chair. 
OBITUARY REFERENCE 
MR. CHAIRMAN : Hon. Members, I refer with pr ofound sorrow to the passing away of Shri 
Suryakantbhai Acharya, a sitting Member of this Ho use, on the 21st of December, 2009 at the age of 
80 years. 
Born at Junagarh in Gujarat in December, 1929, Shri Acharya had his education at M.P. Shah 
College, Shamal Das College and Dharmendra College, Gujarat University. 
A lawyer and a tax consultant by profession, Shri Acharya took special interest in defending the 
weaker sections of the society, serving Musl im orphans and students, and espousing women's 
cause. He worked for the welfare of tribals in the tribal belt of Gujarat. Shri Acharya also took keen 
interest in historical research and Gujarati Lok Sahitya. He was Vice-Chairman of the State Planning 
Commission, Gujarat. 
Shri Acharya had published a book in Gujarati, 'Pahla Junagadh Rajyani Lok Lalato' in 1947. He 
also edited 'Vision 2020', a publication on the future planning in Gujarat. 
Shri Suryakantbhai Acharya represented the State of Gujarat in this House from August 2005 till 
his sad demise. 
In the passing away of Shri Acharya, the countr y has lost a dedicated social worker and a noted 
parliamentarian. 
We deeply mourn the passing away of Shri Suryakantbhai Acharya. 
I request Members to rise in their places and observe silence as a mark of respect to the memory 
of the departed. 
(Hon. Members then stood in silence for one minute.) 
MR. CHAIRMAN : Secretary-General will convey to the members of the bereaved family our 
sense of profound sorrow and deep sympathy. 
As a mark of respect to the memory of Shri Suryakantbhai Acharya, a sitting Member of the 
House, the House stands adjourned to meet tomorrow at 11.00 a.m. 
The House then adjourned at three minutes past eleven of the clock till 
eleven of the clock on Tuesday, the 22nd December, 2009
